Capabilities:
[
 {
  "name": "Spend",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Expenses",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Merchant (text; required)",
     "Expense ID (text)",
     "Date (date)",
     "Submitted by (person; required)",
     "Description (text)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; required; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Receipt (file)",
     "Project Code (text)",
     "Team budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Team budgets)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Submitted (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Paid (last)",
     "Rejected (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Purchase requests",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Item (text; required)",
     "Requested by (person; required)",
     "Amount (money; required)",
     "Category (choice; choices: Software, Travel, Cloud, Meals, Office, Equipment, Training, Other)",
     "Supplier (text)",
     "Reason (long_text)",
     "Needed by (date)",
     "Team budget (link; links to Tools and budgets › Team budgets)",
     "Decision (choice; choices: Approved, Declined)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Requested (start)",
     "Approved",
     "Ordered",
     "Received (last)",
     "Declined (exit)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Spend admin: every row",
   "Spend approver: every row",
   "Purchase approver: every row",
   "Own spend: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": []
 },
 {
  "name": "Tools and budgets",
  "sheets": [
   {
    "name": "Tools",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Vendor (text; required)",
     "Category (text)",
     "Owner (person)",
     "Seats (number)",
     "Annual cost (money)",
     "Renewal date (date)",
     "Seats taken (computed; worked out: the total of Seats in Seat assignments)",
     "Seats free (computed; worked out: Seats − Seats taken)",
     "Status (step)"
    ],
    "steps": [
     "Active (start)",
     "Renewal due",
     "Renewed (last)",
     "Cancelled (exit)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Seat assignments",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Note (text)",
     "New starter (person; required)",
     "Tool (link; required; links to Tools)",
     "Seats (number; required)",
     "Added on (date)"
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "Team budgets",
    "kind": "list",
    "columns": [
     "Team (text; required)",
     "Quarter (text; required)",
     "Budget (money; required)",
     "Spent (computed; worked out: the total of Amount in Expenses at Approved or Paid + the total of Amount in Purchase requests at Approved or Ordered or Received)",
     "Left (computed; worked out: Budget − Spent)"
    ]
   }
  ],
  "roles": [
   "Managers: every row",
   "Tools keeper: every row",
   "Tool owners: their own rows"
  ],
  "rules": [
   "30 days before a tool's renewal date, if it is still Active, move it to Renewal due and email its owner a reminder to renew or cancel it."
  ]
 }
]

Sentences:
1. When an expense is added without a receipt, make it wait on the person who submitted it until the receipt is attached.
2. When an expense has a receipt, whether added with it or attached later, email Lena that it is ready to approve or reject.
3. When an expense is approved, email Lena that it is ready to be paid with the next payroll.
4. When a purchase request is added for more than $2,000, ask Krishna to approve or decline it into its Decision.
5. When a purchase request is added for $2,000 or less, ask Lena to approve or decline it into its Decision.
6. When a purchase request's Decision becomes Approved, move it to Approved.
7. When a purchase request's Decision becomes Declined, move it to Declined.
